page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page, p. 33) with running head at top, main text in one column, and marginal notes in the right margin. Below the text: gathering signature and catchword.

main_text.head: Ab his ad Svevos, Andegavenses & Aragonios pervenit.
Explicatio 1.
main_text.p: Tancredus cum manu Normannorum in Apulia, captis aliquot oppidis, confedit. Ejus Filius Drago A.C. 1039. primus Apuliæ Comes creatus fuit. Wilhelmus Ferrobrachium Calabriam & Capuam; Robertus Guiscardus, à Bettimeo Saracenorum Principe Catanensi, in Siciliam evocatus, Messanam, Panormum, & magnam Siciliæ partem occupavit, eamque; fratri suo Rogerio Bof-fo[?] reliquit, qui primus Siciliæ Comes dictus fuit.Primus Apuliæ Comes sive Neapolis.Primus Siciliæ Comes.
main_text.head: Explicatio 2.
main_text.p: Extincta Roberti Guiscardi progenie Rogerius II, Comes Siciliæ Apuliam, Calabriam, Capuam, ditiones fraternas, Siciliæ conjunxit, ac pri-

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right: "Primus Apuliæ Comes sive Neapolis." (set over five lines, hyphenated "Ne-apolis") and "Primus Siciliæ Comes." Faint mirrored text in the right margin is show-through and was omitted. The word "Bof-fo" is uncertain in its letters and is marked [?]. The bottom line ends mid-word ("pri-") and is treated as the catchword.
